chapter: Trio years, the Sands and Armstrong recollections
title: Waiting in Kansas City while Armstrong went to Hollywood
summary: Armstrong is away about two weeks; Mosley stays with father's family.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Wasn't there a time when Louie--when Louie took off for Hollywood, didn't the band go back to work under Louis Russell's name for the time being?
No. They stayed right there in Kansas City. They waited in Kansas City until Louie came back.
Just doing nothing but laying around?
Louie didn't stay away but about two weeks.
That's all, maybe two weeks or so.
No, but that was fine with me because my folks were there.
All my father's people live there.

I had no problem at all; I was staying with my--they had a great big mansion there and I just had a ball. I was jamming a lot, I was playing my horn. Down on 18th Street, 18th and Bryant they had the Street's Hotel and we used to go down to the ballrooms and play too. We used to go everywhere.
